problem: Existing retained-output digest verification compared declarations across records but explicitly did not prove that declared hashes matched the files' current bytes.

behavior: Requires a non-empty unique path-bound SHA-256 declaration set.
Opens each retained output read-only with O_NOFOLLOW.
Rejects symbolic links and non-regular files.
Streams and hashes current file bytes with SHA-256.
Fails closed on unreadable files or digest mismatch.
Returns observed byte sizes and digests only after all paths verify.

verification.route: deterministic local Node test against byte-equivalent committed source, followed by connector fetch of the committed source

claim_boundary: This proves deterministic source behavior and current-byte SHA-256 agreement for supplied local paths only.
It does not prove retrieval authenticity, exhaustive workflow enumeration, Vercel deployment identity, browser behavior, audio audibility, or physical-device acceptance.
No application deployment was attempted because current operating state prohibits attempts while provider capacity is exhausted.
